coordinates: geocentric; theta from geographic north; longitude east from Greenwich
quadrature: 32 Gauss-Legendre nodes in cos(theta), 64 uniformly spaced longitudes; weights integrate dOmega
axis_convention: positive z_m along the magnetic moment, pointing toward the southern dipole-axis end
axis_is_supplied: direction from degree-one reference model; recover strength from the CSV
provenance: Model-generated surface samples, not raw satellite or observatory measurements.
